items.text: Test role permission when a teacher tries to introduce another teacher to themselves as a teacher.
items.expected: The system rejects the self-introduction because the introducer and introduced roles are the same teacher role, preventing cyclic self-payouts.

items.text: Verify behavior when a teacher attempts to introduce a student to themselves as a teacher-student introduction.
items.expected: The system disallows a teacher introducing a student if it results in a self-reference cycle, ensuring no self-payout occurs.

items.text: Evaluate the handling when a student introduces a teacher to themselves as a student-teacher introduction.
items.expected: Self-introduction cycles where the introducer and introduced form a student-teacher pair to themselves are rejected to prevent invalid payouts.

items.text: Check the system response when a student tries to introduce another student to themselves in a student-student introduction.
items.expected: The system denies the cyclic self-introduction to avoid self-payout situations within the student-student role pair.
